build_deeplab_stem: build a DeepLabStem module with configurable in_channels, out_channels, and batch normalization for ResNet segmentation
build_resnet_deeplab_backbone: build a ResNet backbone from detectron2 config using build_resnet_deeplab_backbone with basic or deeplab stem type
create_deeplab_stem_forward: create a forward pass through DeepLabStem that applies three conv layers with ReLU and max pooling
review_deeplab_stem_init: review the DeepLabStem constructor to understand its three-conv-layer architecture with MSRA weight initialization
refactor_resnet_deeplab_backbone: refactor build_resnet_deeplab_backbone to support custom depth configurations beyond 50, 101, or 152 layer ResNet
